description: Connect a FlowyTeam workspace to ChatGPT to work with tasks, projects, OKR objectives and key results, employee directory entries, attendance and performance cycles in plain language. Typical use: create and update tasks, check objective progress, clock in and out, look up who sits in which department, and review attendance for a date range. The connector handles workspace records only. It does not read or write pay, bank details, identity documents, home addresses, health data or account passwords.

defaultPrompt: What are our company objectives this quarter and how are they progressing?
Create a high-priority task to review the Q3 financial report, due this Friday
Clock me in for today — I'm working from home
